name: Coordinator decide(ask_user) in-run (lineage anchor) → stamp agent.run.clarification-pending
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4b-2 PR-1 — the interactive-pause marker, anchor branch 2 of 2 (loops carrying agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id). Sibling of rule 07. When a run-entity-descended recovery coordinator emits decide(action=ask_user), this stamps agent.run.clarification-pending on the RUN entity via the subject override $entity.triple.agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id; rule 09 consumes the marker and transitions executing→awaiting_approval.

WHICH coordinators this covers: the THREADED recovery coordinators (4b-1a) that carry agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id and ask_user — autoresearch/10b, dev-via-test 02e, 02f-replan, 07b, 07e. They were spawned by run-entity-fired rules so carry NO bare agent.run; their anchor is the threaded agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id. The inherit-anchor recovery coordinators (research/06, autoresearch/10 baseline, dev-via-test/02f first-pass) carry agent.run.entity-id and are the sibling rule 07.

ANCHOR FENCE (agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id length_gt 0): mutually exclusive with rule 07 (length_eq 0), and the lineage PRESENCE is itself the run guard (a plain-chat coordinator has no lineage), so no separate run-less-chat condition is needed. The length_gt 0 guard also ensures the subject-override resolves (the go-reviewer C1 garbage-literal-subject defense).

AUTONOMOUS-MODE INERTNESS (free): same as rule 07 — decide(ask_user) is rejected pre-stamp under restricted_decide_actions=["ask_user"], so this rule cannot fire in autonomous mode.

metadata.marker_object: $entity.instance records WHICH loop asked — forward-compatible with PR-2's resume correlation.
metadata.anchor_fence: agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id length_gt 0 — mutually exclusive with rule 07 (length_eq 0); the lineage presence is itself the run-less-chat guard and guarantees the subject-override resolves (C1 defense).
